title: Apply Skill Thrift Principle to all WAI skills — lean primary files, reference files for verbose content

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Epic to systematically slim every WAI skill file. Primary files carry behavioral instructions only. Verbose content (examples, schemas, deferred specs, onboarding prose, report templates) moves to secondary reference files loaded on-demand.
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not removing functionality. Every behavioral instruction is preserved. Only the token cost of loading the skill changes.

principle: Primary skill file = behavioral instructions only. Secondary {skill}-reference.md in same folder = examples, schemas, verbose specs. Reference files are loaded on-demand, not at wakeup.

per_skill_process: 1. Read the skill file in full
2. Write slimmed primary: behavioral instructions only — keep all rules, drop all examples/schemas/templates that an agent doesn't need loaded unless authoring
3. Write reference file: all moved content, prefaced with a note pointing back to the primary
4. Fix any bugs encountered while editing (e.g. duplicate sections)
5. Sync both files: cp to templates/spoke/skills/{id}/ and WAI-Spoke/commands/
6. Verify line counts and no behavior lost
verify: All processed skills: primary file < 200 lines. Reference file exists. All behavioral instructions still present. Skill loads without error. Sync targets updated.

estimated_savings.tier1_total: ~871 lines saved — largest two files alone

perceive: Read WAI-Spoke/skills/WAI-Skills.jsonl to get full skill list. For each skill with a command_file, read the file in templates/commands/ to get line count. Identify skills over 200 lines that do not yet have a reference file. Use already_done list in this epic to skip completed items.
execute: For each skill over 200 lines without a reference file: 1. Identify verbose sections (examples, schemas, report templates, onboarding prose). 2. Create {skill}-reference.md with the verbose content. 3. Trim primary file to behavioral instructions only (< 200 lines target). 4. Update skill entry in WAI-Skills.jsonl. 5. Update all 6 sync targets if applicable. Batch by 2-3 skills per session.
